_meta.note: Two dogfooding fixes surfaced by a real HeartBeat+CodeGraph run. (RD) deplint over-reports REDUNDANT for spec-first edges whose task maps to NO symbols (a not-yet-existing test file): an empty symbol set means 'no basis to judge', not 'no dependency'. Fix: deplint suppresses REDUNDANT when EITHER endpoint task has zero resolved symbols — both runtimes, byte-identical, gated. (EX) CodeGraph indexes HeartBeat's own `.hb/` scaffold, polluting the graph the code adapter reads (empirically 53→70 files, spurious edges). Fix: a code-adapter helper that idempotently ensures the project's `codegraph.json` excludes `.hb/` (confirmed empirically to drop .hb/ nodes to 0), documented in the code-aware-planning skill as a pre-index step; a harness proof shows the real effect. Core stays domain-neutral (both live in the code adapter + its skill, not the base plan flow / bootstrap). Proof-driven: spec-first, parity, gated + refuted.

phases.title: deplint: no REDUNDANT for tasks the graph can't see (empty symbol set)

tasks.description: Author RED-first. Fixtures: plugin/adapters/code/fixtures/redundant-empty.dag.json (TA requires TB; TC requires TD) + redundant-empty.codemap.json ({edges:[], tasks:{TA:["symA"], TB:[], TC:["symC"], TD:["symD"]}}). Proof docs/howto/gate-examples/deplint-redundant-empty.sh (prints REDUNDANT-EMPTY-OK): run deplint over the fixture and assert the GENUINE redundant edge TC→TD (both endpoints have symbols, no code edge) is STILL reported, while TA→TB is NOT reported (TB has no symbols — the graph has no basis, so it must not be called redundant); and assert node ≡ python byte-identical on the fixture. Must FAIL now (current deplint flags BOTH TA→TB and TC→TD) — confirm red.

tasks.title: Implement the suppression in both runtimes
tasks.description: In plugin/adapters/code/deplint.js and py/src/heartbeat/adapters/code/deplint.py, in the REDUNDANT loop, SKIP the finding when the task's symbol set is empty on either side (task_syms[a] empty OR task_syms[b] empty) — no symbols ⇒ no basis to judge ⇒ not redundant. Do not touch MISSING or COLLISION. Keep the two runtimes byte-identical. Add a py/tests case. Make deplint-redundant-empty.sh pass and keep deplint-parity.sh green.

phases.title: Keep CodeGraph off HeartBeat's own scaffold (.hb/)

tasks.title: Spec-first: proofs for the codegraph.json exclude helper
tasks.description: Author RED-first. Gated proof docs/howto/gate-examples/codegraph-exclude-hb.sh (prints EXCLUDE-HB-OK): running the helper on a temp root creates/updates <root>/codegraph.json so its `exclude` array contains ".hb/"; it is IDEMPOTENT (run twice → exactly one ".hb/", no dup); it PRESERVES an existing config (pre-seed {"include":["src/"]} → include still present AND exclude has .hb/); and node ≡ python (same resulting codegraph.json). Harness proof tests/real-codegraph-exclude-hb.sh (prints REAL-EXCLUDE-HB-OK; harness-first — skips without codegraph/sqlite3): on a sample with a .hb/ file + app code, run the helper then `codegraph init`, and assert the index has ZERO nodes whose file_path is under .hb/ (the real effect) — vs a nonzero baseline without the helper. Both must FAIL/skip appropriately now (no helper yet).

tasks.title: Implement the exclude helper in both runtimes
tasks.description: plugin/adapters/code/codegraph-exclude-hb.js (export ensureHbExcluded(root)) + py/src/heartbeat/adapters/code/codegraph_exclude_hb.py (ensure_hb_excluded(root)): read <root>/codegraph.json if present (else {}), ensure `.hb/` is in the `exclude` array (create the array if missing; no duplicate), preserve all other keys, write it back with stable formatting. CLI: `<cmd> <root>` (default root '.'). Imports nothing from core. Idempotent. Make codegraph-exclude-hb.sh pass; run real-codegraph-exclude-hb.sh green locally (codegraph present).

Update plugin/skills/code-aware-planning/SKILL.md: a pre-index step — before indexing with CodeGraph, exclude HeartBeat's scaffold so the graph reflects the APP not the orchestrator, via `node plugin/adapters/code/codegraph-exclude-hb.js <project>` (node-free twin: python3 -m heartbeat.adapters.code.codegraph_exclude_hb <project>) which adds `.hb/` to the project's codegraph.json `exclude`. Keep real-codegraph-exclude-hb.sh on-demand (referenced from the helper header, like real-codegraph-map.sh). Confirm ALL suites green: node (T101+T102 in GROUPS-PASSED), python, parity, whole-docs prose (T93), self-audit, skill-integrity (T92).
